core_topic: Disputed circumstances of a house visit

events.speaker: Naomi
events.excerpt: You invited me to go for a ride... Then you brought me to your house, which I didn't ask to go to... put on fucking music, closed the door, and showed me pictures... That was not the situation to invite me to your home.

events.speaker: Alex
events.excerpt: I don't really remember showing you baby photos. I remember showing you my paintings... I coerced you into leaving your apartment because I thought maybe getting out... would be healthy... shouldn't have blown a pipe... yes, it's understandable that you're upset because rejection's not nice.
